title: LLM Council
summary: Put a big decision in front of 5 AI advisors who each think differently. They review each other's answers anonymously, then a chairman gives you one verdict showing where they agree and where they clash.
how_to_use: Install it, then say to Claude: "council this: should I do X or Y?" Give it real context (numbers, stakes, constraints). Best for decisions where being wrong is expensive, not quick yes/no questions.
requires: Claude Code. No API keys by default (it uses Claude sub-agents). There's an optional multi-model mode if you want to add your own OpenAI/other keys.
